applications.inference: FLEX and FLEX-2 measure how diluents extinguish burning droplets and are the nearest PSI suppression data. No PSI table is a water-mist test, so this link is an inference.
applications.statement: Fine-water-mist extinguishers developed for use on the ISS have practical applications on Earth.

applications.application: Smoke detector that tells smoke from dust
applications.inference: Documented in the challenge statement: an instrument used for smoke detection in SAME and SAME-R was used to detect dust in DAFT and DAFT-2. The 1970s shuttle detector itself predates these investigations, so the spinoff is historical and the link to the PSI tables is the instrument reuse only.
applications.statement: A 1970s smoke detector developed for the shuttle discriminates smoke from dust, giving fewer nuisance alarms, with industrial uses such as mining.

applications.application: Firefighter air tanks and breathing gear
applications.inference: No PSI combustion investigation is linked: this is spacesuit hardware history, not combustion data.
applications.statement: A 1970s adaptation of spacesuit technology improved firefighter air tanks and breathing gear.

applications.inference: No PSI combustion investigation is linked: this is spacesuit materials history. Fabric flammability tests in the PSI tables (Saffire, BASS) address spacecraft materials, not firefighter clothing.
